Derived tables raw variables (e.g., population_density) always kept. compile_acs_data(), partition runs querying: dropped tables partial-table sub-variables warned early possible; function errors none user’s requested tables available. title: ACS Background and Best Practices
text: American Community Survey (ACS) ongoing nationwide survey conducted U.S. Census Bureau. Unlike decennial census, attempts count every person country every ten years, ACS surveys sample roughly 3.5 million addresses every year. Census Bureau uses responses produce estimates population characteristics—demographics, housing, income, education, employment, —geographies ranging entire nation individual block groups. (Unlike decennial census, ACS produce block-level estimates.) ACS survey, results estimates associated sampling error, exact counts. Every ACS estimate accompanied margin error (MOE) quantifies uncertainty around . See Drawing Inferences Accounting Survey Error urbnindicators helps work MOEs.

text: illustration, ’ll create four quadrants DC assigning tracts quadrant based centroid coordinates. text: ACS data available standard geographies (tracts, counties, states, etc.), many analyses require non-standard areas like neighborhoods, school zones, planning districts. interpolate_acs() aggregates source data user-defined geography, properly re-deriving percentages propagating margins error: See vignette("custom-geographies") .
code: dc_tracts = compile_acs_data(   tables = "snap",   years = 2024,   geography = "tract",   states = "DC",   spatial = TRUE)  ## assign each tract to a quadrant based on its centroid dc_tracts = dc_tracts %>%   mutate(     centroid = sf::st_centroid(geometry),     lon = sf::st_coordinates(centroid)[, 1],     lat = sf::st_coordinates(centroid)[, 2],     quadrant = case_when(       lon <  median(lon) & lat >= median(lat) ~ "NW",       lon >= median(lon) & lat >= median(lat) ~ "NE",       lon <  median(lon) & lat <  median(lat) ~ "SW",       lon >= median(lon) & lat <  median(lat) ~ "SE")) %>%   select(-centroid, -lon, -lat)  ## aggregate tracts to quadrants dc_quadrants = interpolate_acs(   .data = dc_tracts,   target_geoid = "quadrant")  dc_quadrants %>%   sf::st_drop_geometry() %>%   select(GEOID, snap_received_percent, snap_received_percent_M) #>   GEOID snap_received_percent snap_received_percent_M #> 1    NE            0.15951925             0.019448994 #> 2    NW            0.07036185             0.006889427 #> 3    SE            0.24445974             0.012073306 #> 4    SW            0.06525691             0.012003668

title: Aggregate or interpolate ACS data to custom geographies — interpolate_acs
text: Aggregate interpolate ACS data source geographies user-defined target geographies. Supports two modes: Complete nesting (weight = NULL): source geography maps entirely one target geography. Count variables summed, percentages recalculated summed components, intensive variables (medians, averages) computed population-weighted averages. Fractional allocation (weight = "column_name"): Source geographies can split across multiple targets using crosswalk weights. Count variables MOEs multiplied weight summing. Percentages recalculated interpolated components. Intensive variables use allocated population weights. fractional-allocation mode, area variables (area_land_sq_kilometer, area_water_sq_kilometer, area_land_water_sq_kilometer) population_density_land_sq_kilometer (MOE) set NA result. Crosswalk weights typically represent population share rather area share, scaling source-geography areas weight meaningful. need area density target geographies, join area measurements onto returned data frame. MOE propagation uses Census Bureau approximation formulas throughout. Crosswalk weights treated constants (sampling error). NA handling: Missing values (NA) aggregated input columns propagate corresponding target geographies — .e., source geography within target NA column summed averaged, target's value column NA. one-time warning issued listing affected columns. Filter impute NAs upstream different behavior desired.

text: compile_acs_data() now driven tables parameter: request registered tables name (see list_tables()), raw ACS table codes (e.g., "B25070", auto-processed runtime), /custom variable definitions — mixed freely inside list(). old behavior (tables) remains default tables omitted. variables parameter deprecated ignored. definition helpers consolidated: define_percent() (= TRUE batch mode) replaces define_across_percent(); define_sum() replaces define_across_sum(); define_complement() replaces define_one_minus(). Single-string numerators/denominators interpreted regular expressions. select_variables_by_name() filter_variables() longer exported; use get_acs_codebook() variable discovery. list_acs_variables() removed; use list_variables(). Literal $ characters now stripped generated variable names, income- rent-band columns (e.g., B25074/B25106) syntactic: household_income_..._less_than_$10000 becomes household_income_..._less_than_10000. renter cost-burden measures now carry explicit tenure label: cost_burdened_30percentormore_* cost_burdened_50percentormore_* now cost_burdened_renter_30percentormore_* cost_burdened_renter_50percentormore_*, disambiguating new owner-side measures. Two variables renamed accuracy consistency: employment_civilian_labor_force_percent now employment_civilian_labor_force_employed_percent (employment rate — employed persons civilian labor force), median_household_income_nhpi now median_household_income_nhpi_alone, matching sibling race-iteration names. Census API key now required functions read ACS variable dictionary (including list_variables() get_acs_codebook()), Census Bureau’s variables metadata endpoint now requires key. Set one tidycensus::census_api_key("YOUR_KEY", install = TRUE). safe_divide() now returns NA (0) nonzero numerator divided zero; 0/0 still returns 0. Raw ACS table codes now always auto-processed, even registered table covers code: tables = "B22003" returns auto-processed table label-derived names, tables = "snap" returns registered version (previously raw code silently upgraded registered table). Requesting one call returns registered version drops auto-processed one warning, since two fetch duplicate variables.

title: urbnindicators 0.1.0
text: Block-group geography: compile_acs_data(geography = "block group") supported 2013 later (explicit states required). Tables ACS publish block-group level dropped warning; list_tables(geography = "block group") lists available. Custom geographies: interpolate_acs() aggregates (complete nesting) interpolates (fractional allocation via crosswalk weights) estimates user-defined geographies, recalculating percentages propagating margins error Census Bureau approximation formulas. Custom derived variables: pass define_percent() / define_sum() / define_complement() / define_metadata() objects compile_acs_data(tables = ...); results computed, documented codebook, receive margins error automatically. Interactive viewer: view_acs_data() launches local Shiny app map results, interpolate uploaded hand-drawn target geographies, benchmark differences statistical significance, export data images. Caching: compile_acs_data(cache = TRUE) caches raw ACS query results disk (one entry per geography-year-state-table) reuses across calls R sessions, repeat overlapping requests – including changed tables selections – re-download missing. Entries never expire (published five-year ACS estimates change); new clear_acs_cache() deletes reclaim disk space. Universe statements codebook. codebook gains universe column carrying Census Bureau’s published universe statement variable (e.g., “Households”, “Population 25 years ”); derived variables inherit numerator’s universe. Available 2020+ vintages (API publish universes earlier years). Owner cost-burden measures. tenure_by_housing_costs (B25106) now publishes owner cost-burden percentages (incomes, incomes $35,000, incomes $50,000) -tenures headline measure; new owner_cost_burden table (B25091) adds 30-percent--50-percent--(severe) burden shares mortgage status, plus combined -owners severe-burden measure. Denominators exclude households whose cost ratio computable (zero/negative income; renters paying cash rent), consistent renter measures. Unregistered ACS tables requested code auto-processed: label hierarchy parsed percentages computed nearest parent subtotal (configurable via denominator parameter). years defaults recent ACS five-year vintage expected available, rather hard-coded year.
